title: story-031's commit subject and eight in-code provenance markers cite the retired label V3-L-14; the ledger promoted that finding to V3-M-07 in run-10, so the source is un-greppable from the current label
description: story-031's commit subject and eight in-code provenance markers cite the retired label V3-L-14. Run-10 promoted that finding to V3-M-07, so the source is un-greppable from the current ledger label.
impact: No functional impact whatsoever -- pure documentation/traceability. Fingerprint is unaffected (severity is not part of the hash), so ledger reconciliation is unharmed. Raised only so the run-11 closure of V3-M-07 is greppable from source.
recommendation: On any future touch of these comments, cite 'V3-M-07 (ex V3-L-14)'. No code change warranted on its own account.
notableSideEffect: The V3-L-14 label is retired and deliberately NOT reused -- labels persist once assigned and are never renumbered. This is why the V3-L family skips 14 (V3-L-13 -> V3-L-15).
